name: Close-Quarters Shooting
summary: Making a ranged weapon attack while a hostile creature is within 5 ft normally imposes disadvantage. A weapon with the Close-Quarters property ignores this disadvantage. Pistols may be drawn and fired in melee unless another rule prevents it.
